items.title: Driverless Waymo Taxis Reportedly Stalled and Blocked Traffic on Flooded Streets in San Francisco
items.summary: A Waymo driverless taxi reportedly stopped in a traffic lane during flooding in San Francisco, California. A passenger waited about 30 minutes for staff to move it remotely.
